channel.title: Midnight blog - en - Last 7 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Language: en | Range: Last 7 days

item.title: When address lookup fails, provide a usable manual route
item.description: A missing lookup result should lead to an appropriate manual route that works through confirmation and storage.

item.title: Can Scripts Read a Cookie Marked Secure?
item.description: Secure controls transport; HttpOnly controls script access. Review request inclusion and server authorization separately.

item.title: Why a Same-Origin Resource Policy Still Needs base-uri
item.description: A strict resource allowlist does not constrain the document base. Review relative URL destinations and choose a policy the page can support.

item.title: When sticky ignores page scrolling, inspect ancestor overflow
item.description: Identify the scrolling ancestor, effective inset, and available movement before changing sticky positioning.

item.title: Why a Docker Build ARG Disappears at Runtime
item.description: A build argument does not automatically become a container setting. Trace build inputs, image defaults, and runtime consumption.

item.title: FormData append keeps repeated names: define field cardinality first
item.description: Choose append or replacement from the field contract, then verify how the server handles repeated names.

item.title: Compare Three Dry Runs Before Using git clean
item.description: Compare ordinary, inclusive, and ignored-only previews. Keep the directory and options aligned before choosing files to remove.

item.title: For HTTP 415, inspect the content you sent before changing Accept
item.description: Separate request format and encoding from response preferences when investigating an HTTP 415 response.

item.title: When a valid zero disappears, check the default condition
item.description: Distinguish missing values, valid zero settings, and invalid input before choosing a default expression.

item.title: Why emptyDir Survives a Container Crash but Not Pod Removal
item.description: emptyDir survives container crashes within a Pod. Pod removal deletes its data, so recovery requirements must name that boundary.

item.title: Telemetry Arrived, but Which Service Produced It?
item.description: Telemetry delivery does not prove service identity. Check resource names, initialization, and exported attributes separately.

item.title: Why does locator.all() miss a dynamically loaded list?
item.description: Prove list completeness before enumeration, then account for empty loops, changing items, and virtualized views.

item.title: Why can a deferred constraint fail after the final write succeeds?
item.description: Separate writes, deferred checks, and commit confirmation so transaction errors reach the correct application branch.

item.title: A foreign key exists. Does the child-side index exist too?
item.description: Check relationship direction, existing indexes, and parent operations before assuming a foreign key covers lookup cost.

item.title: How do JSON null, SQL NULL, and a missing key differ?
item.description: Preserve JSON type and key presence before combining missing fields, explicit clearing, and an absent SQL value.

item.title: Why does SUM produce NULL when no rows match?
item.description: Keep no rows, missing amounts, and a genuine zero distinct before choosing defaults for a PostgreSQL aggregate.

item.title: Read PromQL offset as Two Explicit Time Windows
item.description: Read offset through its evaluation time, window width, and time anchor before treating a historical curve as a useful baseline.

item.title: Why can pytest match accept an unintended exception message?
item.description: Define the accepted error text before using regular-expression search, message equality, or exception notes.

item.title: A Healthy Overall Graph Is Not Enough to Expand a Canary
item.description: Separate canary and control signals, then check shared failures and absolute service objectives before expanding a rollout.

item.title: A successful click does not settle target size and spacing
item.description: Check the active target and nearby controls before treating one successful click as evidence of adequate target size.

item.title: What does a “Submit” button ask the user to confirm?
item.description: Match button labels to saving, review and payment, then check the resulting state and failure feedback.

item.title: Does default-src restrict where a form submits?
item.description: CSP form destinations need their own directive. Check allowed targets, browser redirect behavior, and business outcomes separately.

item.title: Give component width a measurable box-model contract

item.title: Use collapsed details for help, keep action conditions visible
item.description: Separate supplementary help from information users need before deciding, and make disclosure controls descriptive.

item.title: Why a cached Docker build can use an old package index
item.description: Package freshness needs an explicit cache decision and installed-version evidence. Combining update and installation fixes a narrower mismatch.

item.title: Do separate Git worktrees have separate references and stashes?
item.description: Worktrees keep separate HEADs and indexes while sharing ordinary references and stashes. Verify record ownership before restoring unfinished work.

item.title: Does an empty lookup justify HTTP 410?
item.description: Distinguish missing resources from traceable retirement decisions, with separate checks for disclosure and caching.

item.title: Why Array.fill makes several rows share one editable object
item.description: Repeated object references are shared state; construct independent editable rows and verify nested data and saved identities.

item.title: Why can nested settings change after Object.freeze?
item.description: Shallow freezing protects the outer object; nested references, accessors and recursive handling need explicit boundaries.

item.title: Why ready containers can leave a Pod waiting for a readiness gate
item.description: Custom readiness gates need every listed condition True; missing conditions count as False. Assign status ownership beyond container probes.

item.title: Check histogram values against their declared unit
item.description: Check measurement values, histogram boundaries and downstream thresholds against one unit contract.

item.title: Why an allowed camera policy does not make a camera usable

item.title: Passing requests through route.continue does not preserve the cache environment
item.description: Playwright routing disables HTTP caching, so browser-cache acceptance needs its own controlled environment and evidence.

item.title: Why an explicit NULL does not use a PostgreSQL column default
item.description: Keep omission, explicit clearing and supplied values distinct so database defaults receive the intended input.

item.title: Why moving a LEFT JOIN condition into WHERE removes unmatched rows

item.title: Why does descending time order put missing timestamps first?

item.title: Why Prometheus increase can be fractional for integer counters

item.title: Two pytest.approx tolerances are alternatives, not two mandatory gates

item.title: Bound admission and degradation during service overload
